questions.text: Which explorer sailed the ocean blue in 1492?
questions.explanation: Columbus reached the Caribbean in October 1492.

questions.text: Which Venetian merchant-explorer's travels to China were recorded in a famous medieval book?
questions.explanation: The Travels of Marco Polo described his journeys across Asia.

questions.text: Who led the first expedition to reach the South Pole, in 1911?
questions.explanation: Amundsen's team reached the Pole in December 1911.

questions.text: Which Norse explorer is traditionally credited with reaching North America around the year 1000?
questions.explanation: Sagas say Leif Erikson reached a land called Vinland, and Norse remains at L'Anse aux Meadows support this.

questions.text: Which Portuguese explorer led the first European sea voyage to India in 1498?
questions.explanation: Da Gama reached Calicut by sailing round Africa.

questions.text: Which English captain charted the east coast of Australia in 1770?
questions.explanation: Cook landed at Botany Bay in April 1770.

questions.text: Whose expedition completed the first circumnavigation of the Earth between 1519 and 1522?
questions.explanation: Magellan died en route, but one of his ships returned to Spain.

questions.text: Which two men made the first confirmed ascent of Everest in 1953?
questions.explanation: Hillary and Tenzing reached the summit on 29 May 1953.

questions.text: Which pair led an overland expedition to the Pacific from 1804 to 1806?
questions.explanation: Lewis and Clark explored the Louisiana Purchase territory.

questions.text: Whom did Henry Morton Stanley greet with the words Dr ... I presume?
questions.explanation: Stanley found Livingstone near Lake Tanganyika in 1871.

questions.text: Which Norwegian explorer sailed the raft Kon-Tiki across the Pacific in 1947?
questions.explanation: Heyerdahl's voyage aimed to show ancient transpacific contact was possible.

questions.text: Which Spanish conquistador overthrew the Aztec Empire?
Which explorer led the Endurance expedition of 1914-17?
questions.explanation: Endurance was crushed by pack ice and the entire crew survived.

questions.text: Which Dutch navigator sighted Tasmania and New Zealand in 1642?
questions.explanation: Tasman was the first known European to sight both.

questions.text: Who was the first European to see the Pacific from the Americas by crossing Panama in 1513?
questions.explanation: Balboa waded into the ocean and claimed it for Spain.

spares.text: Who became the first human in space in 1961?
Which ship carried the Pilgrims to America in 1620?
spares.explanation: The Mayflower landed at Plymouth, Massachusetts.

spares.text: Which French explorer founded Quebec City in 1608?
spares.explanation: Champlain established the settlement on the St. Lawrence River.
